thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency (us-west) > SLO for 10m (SLO burn 2.3%). Endpoint: /v1/generate. Pager: devin.

maria (SRE): acked. jumping in. any immediate customer impact?

devin (oncall): ack. seeing tail on p99 and a smattering of timeouts. no 5xx spike yet. adding traces.

maria (SRE): logs show repeated slow KV fetches around 10:41-10:47. snippet: ```ERR kv_fetch_timeout key=prompt-cache shard=7 duration=225ms```

devin (oncall): that aligns with a small spike in long-running batches. autoscaler didn't kick for a few mins. checking autoscale events.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> INC_2026_usw_p99_latency. State: triggered -> acknowledged by devin at 10:48.

maria (SRE): quick mitigation options: 1) force add capacity to pool-usw (scale +2) 2) enable model-fallback to lighter quantized variant for non-sensitive routes 3) temporarily reduce batch window to favor latency. Thoughts?

devin (oncall): pushing +2 GPUs to pool-usw now (command run: `infractl pool scale --name pool-usw --delta 2`). ETA ~90s. Also flipping prefix-KV cache warmup to aggressive for the hot shard.

leo (oncall-next): heads-up, I'll take handoff in 25m. if we need sustained action we should open an incident.

maria (SRE): monitoring p95 as well. if p95 steady, we can avoid full incident page. also enabling fallback routing now: `router set-fallback --route /v1/generate --model m-small-q4`.

devin (oncall): scale completed at 10:50, infra logs show new instances healthy. after scale p99 dropped ~40%, p95 stable.

maria (SRE): nice. still seeing a handful of slow KV ops — will follow up with infra team to investigate shard 7 eviction policy.

devin (oncall): leaving a brief note in runbook: "10:48 ack, +2 GPUs to pool-usw, enabled m-small fallback, KV warmup tweaks. p99 reduced. monitor 30m."

incident-bot: Note: automated alert suppression window suggestion: snooze further pages for 10m if p99 remains below SLO for 5m.

maria (SRE): agree. I'm going to set a 10m snooze to prevent cascade. will create a postmortem if we see recurrence.

leo (oncall-next): thanks team. I'll pick up checks at handoff and loop in infra for the KV shard investigation. tagging @infra-team for follow-up. :eyes:

devin (oncall): no customer-facing errors observed, brief latency blip only. marking INC_2026_usw_p99_latency as mitigated. closing pager but leaving monitoring active. :white_check_mark:

maria (SRE): quick retro TODOs: - investigate KV eviction threshold for shard 7 - adjust autoscaler aggressiveness for pool-usw - add runbook step to fallback to m-small for sustained p99 burns

leo (oncall-next): noted. handing off to me. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
